method.country_note: Outlet countries describe origin. Claimant countries describe an office, organization or stated residence, not assumed citizenship.
method.claim_type_note: A fact claim is a checkable statement, not a fact verified by this graph. Opinions, predictions, legal positions and promises are marked separately.
method.edge_note: Green arrows point from a supporting claim to the claim receiving support. Grey comparisons have no assigned direction. Solid red arrows point from a source claim to a target claim it is proposed to contradict. Red direction follows the analyst-assigned comparison order. Every proposed conflict retains its reasoning and scope limits for human review.
method.attention_note: Attention is a qualitative reading of the saved article, with paragraph locators; it is not a measured share of words.
method.endorsement_note: A quoted speaker’s view is separate from the article narrator’s view. No outlet-wide position is inferred from one article.
method.cleaning_note: Uses saved recovered text. Kyiv Independent later Most Popular / News Feed material is excluded; original paragraph numbers retained. FT wrapped lines are joined into logical paragraphs.
